definition_used: Complaints about one or more companies/institutions in addition to concerns about the original article. RW may also use this reason for cases in which something about one or more companies/institutions is called into question following any notice, i.e., when complaints escalate to being entirely company/institution-based.
caution: The reason focuses on complaints about companies/institutions, which may relate to post-publication oversight but does not directly assert issues with research content, authorship, or editorial processes. It is a status/notice signal about external concerns, not a substantive manuscript integrity category.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes complaints about companies/institutions, which can involve investigations or concerns raised after publication, aligning with post-publication transparency and due process oversight. However, it does not inherently indicate problems with research content, authorship, or editorial governance, so only the oversight category is assigned broadly.
